rationale: The agent looked up the user by name and ZIP and retrieved user/order details, but then executed multiple order-changing writes (two order cancellations and one return) without obtaining explicit user confirmation beforehand, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action. The user also preferred to do one thing at a time, yet the agent performed multiple actions at once. Additionally, the agent did not provide the requested tracking number for the tablet nor address the refund/reorder request or hand off to a human if it could not be handled. Given these issues, the interaction did not complete the user’s request in line with policy.
